context: A boss reviews an IT project plan with his manager
purpose: Teach: 複製/コマンド/ソリューション/リソース/属性/伝達/遂行/実証

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今回のITソリューションについて、進捗を報告してくれ。
lines.en: Report on the progress of this IT solution.
lines.style: Formal, authoritative tone of a senior boss.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、現在は新システムの実証実験を行っている段階です。
lines.en: Yes, we are currently in the proof-of-concept testing stage of the new system.
lines.style: Polite, measured reply from a diligent middle manager.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど。人的リソースの配分は問題ないのか?
lines.en: I see. Are there any issues with the allocation of human resources?
lines.style: Probing question with concerned executive tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 技術部から二名追加してもらい、業務遂行に支障はありません。
lines.en: We added two people from the tech department, so there are no obstacles to carrying out the work.
lines.style: Reassuring, factual report with confidence in the team.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: データの複製とバックアップ体制はどうなっている?
lines.en: What about the data duplication and backup setup?
lines.style: Sharp follow-up showing attention to risk management.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: サーバー上でコマンドを実行して、毎晩自動でバックアップが取れる仕組みです。
lines.en: We run a command on the server, and backups are taken automatically every night.
lines.style: Technical explanation delivered clearly and professionally to the boss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ユーザー属性の管理と、現場への指示の伝達もしっかり頼むぞ。
lines.en: Make sure user attribute management and instructions to the field are properly conveyed.
lines.style: Firm directive emphasizing operational discipline, distinct timbre that anchors the scene

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。来月までに効果を実証できる数値をご報告いたします。
lines.en: Understood. I will report numbers demonstrating the effectiveness by next month.
lines.style: Committed, deferential closing remark from manager.
